popCulture.title: Aello
popCulture.description: Storm-swift among the Harpies — Hesiod's Aello keeps pace with the winds beside Ocypete.

popCulture.title: Harpy
popCulture.description: The sisters endure as bird-women of snatching and stench — from Phineus' table to Aeneas' Strophades.

popCulture.title: Jason and the Argonauts
popCulture.creator: Don Chaffey / Ray Harryhausen
popCulture.description: Harryhausen's stop-motion Harpies torment blind Phineus — the Argonaut chase that fixed the sisters for modern screens.
